question: If ASD already performs better in 3/4 postures, what exactly is the reason to buy P-24?

differentiators_examined.clinical_materiality_test: Does a 0.4s response advantage produce a measurable clinical benefit?
differentiators_examined.materiality_evidence: NONE — postural transitions take 1-3 seconds. ICP dynamics operate on timescales of minutes, not sub-seconds. No clinical study establishes that 0.4s valve response affects outcome.
differentiators_examined.verdict: UNESTABLISHED — advantage is real but not yet shown to matter clinically.

differentiators_examined.clinical_materiality_test: Does proportional flow produce less pressure oscillation than binary switching?
differentiators_examined.materiality_evidence: NONE — no model of ICP oscillation as a function of valve binary-switching exists. The 'smoothness' advantage is a hypothesis, not an established effect.
differentiators_examined.verdict: UNESTABLISHED — would need an ICP oscillation model + clinical correlation to be material.

differentiators_examined.claim: Lower nominal upright flow than standard shunt
differentiators_examined.materiality_evidence: PARTIAL — 0.417 is within 2x of target (0.3). But ASD's 0.225 is closer to target. So this 'advantage' is actually a disadvantage vs ASD on this metric.
differentiators_examined.verdict: WEAK — only an advantage vs standard shunt, not vs ASD. ASD wins this metric.

differentiators_examined.clinical_materiality_test: Does P-24 adapt to patient-specific physiology better than ASD?
differentiators_examined.materiality_evidence: NONE — both are passive devices. Neither adapts. P-24's compressible element is geometry-fixed at manufacture time, just like ASD's threshold.

differentiators_examined.clinical_materiality_test: Is P-24 less sensitive to body orientation than ASD?
differentiators_examined.materiality_evidence: NONE — both devices respond to postural pressure differential, not orientation per se. ASD's threshold is orientation-independent in the model; P-24's compression is also orientation-independent (gravity-on-piston geometry not modeled).

differentiators_examined.clinical_materiality_test: Is P-24 cheaper / simpler to manufacture than ASD?
differentiators_examined.materiality_evidence: NEGATIVE — ASD is a simpler device (binary valve). P-24 has a compressible element (elastomer or gas spring) which adds manufacturing complexity, tolerance stack-up, and failure modes (fatigue, gas diffusion).
differentiators_examined.verdict: DISADVANTAGE — P-24 is more complex to manufacture than ASD.

differentiators_examined.clinical_materiality_test: Is P-24 easier to integrate into existing shunt systems than ASD?
differentiators_examined.materiality_evidence: NONE — both are drop-in hydraulic elements. No integration advantage either way.
NEGATIVE — P-24's compressible element adds cost. ASD has decades of manufacturing maturity and likely lower unit cost.
differentiators_examined.verdict: DISADVANTAGE — P-24 likely costs more than ASD.

differentiators_examined.clinical_materiality_test: Is there any other quantitative property where P-24 outperforms ASD?
differentiators_examined.materiality_evidence: NONE — VVUQ P(flow<0.5)=78.8% vs ASD 98.7%. ASD wins on robustness too.
differentiators_examined.verdict: NONE — no additional measurable property identified where P-24 wins.

decision.action: DOWNGRADE CLAIM STRENGTH — P-24 retains T1 (computationally supported) but buyer package may NOT claim superiority over ASD. The two unestablished advantages (response speed, proportional control) become the decisive experiment's primary endpoints. If bench data shows neither is clinically material, P-24 enters repair pipeline (Article XXXVI §4). If repair fails, cemetery.
promotion_blocked: Buyer package may not say 'better than ASD'
Buyer package may not say 'robust' without qualification (78.8% not 98.7%)
Posterior may not be promoted above 0.6 until external data arrives

honest_one_line: P-24 has ZERO established clinical advantages over ASD. Two potential advantages (response speed, proportional control) are UNESTABLISHED and become the decisive bench test's primary endpoints. P-24 retains T1 but may not be marketed as superior to ASD.
